in_arabic.name: رمضان

in_urdu.name: رمضان

in_urdu.long_meaning: رمضان اسلامی تقویم کا نوین مہینہ ہے جس میں مسلمان روزہ رکھتے ہیں، یہ مہینہ مغفرت اور رحمت کا مہینہ سمجھا جاتا ہے، اور یہ وہ مہینہ ہے جس میں قرآن مسلم دنیا کے لئے نازل ہوا

data.cultural_impact: Ramadan is a deeply rooted tradition in Muslim communities all over the world. It is a time for unity, refinement of character, and strengthening of bonds. Families and communities come together to break their fasts in the evening, sharing traditional foods and stories. Ramadan is also a time for giving, with many Muslims donating to charities and offering their time and resources to those in need. In many countries, the month of Ramadan is marked by a lively cultural scene, with markets and festivals filled with unique traditions and rich history.
data.spiritual_significance: Ramadan is a time for spiritual reflection and growth for Muslims. Fasting from dawn until sunset is a way to practise self-control, sacrifice, and empathy for those who are less fortunate. Muslims also engage in prayers, reading of the Quran, and acts of righteousness during this month. Ramadan is believed to be a time when the doors of heaven are open, allowing for increased blessings and divine forgiveness. It is a time to seek closer connection with Allah and to purify one's heart and soul in preparation for the Hajj pilgrimage and the hope of attaining eternal paradise.
